sentences.en: In early times, inventions were often stumbled upon by accident.
sentences.zh: 在早期时代，许多发明往往是偶然发现的。

sentences.en: The stout man leaped over the shallow ditch and stumbled.
sentences.zh: 那个身材魁梧的人跳过了浅沟，却绊了一下。

sentences.en: He found your keys. He stumbled upon them by chance.
sentences.zh: 他找到了你的钥匙。他是偶然间找到的。
